patch_description:
Prepend a global RX rotation layer before the initial RY layer. This introduces an orthogonal rotation axis early in the circuit, enabling better initial feature separation and potentially improving worst_group_margin (critical for robust separation on hard samples). 

The RX layer uses a single shared parameter across all 8 qubits, adding only 1 new distinct parameter while providing an additional degree of freedom that's orthogonal to the subsequent RY rotations. This approach has driven expressivity gains in multi-phase ansätze while maintaining shallow, efficient circuits.

This targets:
1. Improving worst_group_margin (currently 0.36) by providing better initial state preparation
2. Reducing convergence time by giving the optimizer more flexibility early
3. Maintaining or improving parameter efficiency (1 new param is negligible with 7 existing)
